tabs.content:
// 1. Generic structure for an aggregation in KQL
Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count()


// 2. Group By a column 
Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count() by BikepointID


// 3. Multiple aggregates
Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count(), MinBikes = min(No_Bikes) by BikepointID

// 4. Using countif to count empty bike stations events 

Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count(), TotalEventsEmptyStation = countif(No_Bikes == 0 ) by BikepointID

// 5. Adding the EmptyStationPercentage
Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count(), TotalEventsEmptyStation = countif(No_Bikes == 0 ) by BikepointID
| extend EmptyStationPercentage = round(todouble(TotalEventsEmptyStation) / todouble(TotalEvents),2)*100

// 6. Returning only the stations which have an EmptyStationPercentage of != 0 
Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count(), TotalEventsEmptyStation = countif(No_Bikes == 0 ) by BikepointID
| extend EmptyStationPercentage = round(todouble(TotalEventsEmptyStation) / todouble(TotalEvents),2)*100
| where EmptyStationPercentage != 0

// 7. Binning by ingestion_time()
Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count() by bin(ingestion_time(), 12m)

// 8. Binning by ingestion_time() and BikepointID 
Raw_Bike
| summarize TotalEvents = count() by bin(ingestion_time(), 12m), BikepointID
